title: quercus coccifera var. calliprinos
intro: Quercus coccifera var. calliprinos, commonly known as the Kermes oak or Kermes oak shrub, is a type of evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, supporting cardiovascular health and immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Quercus coccifera var. calliprinos include astringent, antiseptic, and anti-arthritic effects, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
